verdict.rationale: Ramp's own product page describes this exact workflow: a vendor invoice is matched to its PO, coded to the right GL account, routed for approval, and paid. Its AI agents are also documented as handling auto-coding, approval routing and automatic payment, and learning from past invoices. The evidence is mostly marketing-level, though. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on PO-matching logic (e.g., 2-/3-way match, exception handling), and independent or hands-on corroboration of invoice-to-PO matching.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have vendor invoices automatically matched to purchase orders, coded, and routed for payment

citations.quote: A vendor invoice is dragged into Ramp, automatically matched to its PO, coded to the right GL account, routed for approval, and paid
Four AI agents handle auto-coding, fraud prevention, approval routing, and automatic payment
Learning from past invoices, Ramp's agent applies your logic instantly during processing
